newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian shares firmer, rise seen.
newsitem.headline: Russian shares firmer, rise seen.

text.p: Leading Russian shares closed up in active trading but off midday highs due to profit-taking on Wednesday but some traders said prices would rise again at the end of the week.
"Perhaps closer to the middle of the day buyers appeared in London and New York and then Russian banks decided to take profits on that rather strong growth," said Aton trader Boris Shvedsky.

The Russian Trading System 23-share index rose 5.09 percent on $41.5 million traded in the whole market -- considered healthy for the Russian market -- to close at 303.34 after Tuesday's closing 288.63.
National power utility UES ordinaries closed at $0.2100 after $0.1995 on Tuesday and Mosenergo was $1.214 after Tuesday's closing $1.170. Oil company Surgutneftegaz was $0.755 after $0.740.

Traders said Western investors as well as Russian had been active in trading but did not think firmer prices on leading shares for the second day running indicated the start of a consistent up trend in the market.
Announcements on Tuesday about tightening government regulation of UES sparked a jump in company share prices which pulled other leading shares up with it.
Some dealers said they expected more profit-taking tomorrow and a consolidation of the market at Wednesday's levels.
But others said prices could rise further over the next few days.
"At the end of the week I expect a rise," said Shvedsky.
